notes.text: The supplied notice abbreviates the title as ר׳, rendered R'. Safra transliterates ספרא; the printed ע:. is rendered 70b under the colon convention. The name and citation are the whole notice.

The linked Bavli has Rabbi Ila’a teaching in the name of Rabbi Yehudah ben Safra. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1673&lang=en) cites that passage with ben Safra, whereas Hyman’s notice has bar Safra.
